revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a narrow service hallway with utility doors, exposed pipes, matte concrete non-glossy floor, and warm practical interior lighting. Right-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A middle-aged adult with a medium build wearing a tan utility jacket and dark jeans, in brown and cream clothing, is sitting on one bent leg with the other leg extended, hips low but torso clearly non-horizontal. The scene should look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, with a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising style. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
